hook_text: Your sandwich, your pap and even your boerewors are full of stored sunshine. Really!
clip_script: A maize farm near Ventersdorp. Sunlight pours onto wide green leaves. The leaves catch it and turn water and air into food. The plant packs that energy into its kernels. Dry them, mill them, cook them: pap! Your energy came from the pap. The pap's energy came from the maize. The maize's energy came from the Sun. And your boerewors? The cow ate grass. The grass used sunlight. Every bite you eat is stored sunshine.
visual_style: Whiteboard Sun sending yellow arrows to a maize field, the energy stored as yellow dots in the cobs, then the dots moving into a pot of pap and a learner.
mood: Bright and amazed, like discovering a hidden secret.
pacing: Sunlight to leaf, leaf to stored food, stored food to our plates, with one big reveal at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and trace one food on your plate back to the Sun.
